name: lingbot-map
description: [ECCV 2026 Best Paper Award Candidate] LingBot-Map: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
one_liner: Research code that lets a robot or camera build an accurate 3D map of a space in real time as it moves through it, instead of after the fact.
buyer: A robotics or drone company building autonomous navigation products that need real-time 3D mapping, and has an ML team able to integrate research code.
business_use_cases: A warehouse robotics company integrates it to improve real-time mapping accuracy for autonomous forklifts.
A drone-mapping startup uses it to deliver faster, more accurate site surveys for construction and real estate clients.
An AR headset maker evaluates it for real-time scene reconstruction to anchor digital objects in physical space.

money_ideas.idea: License an optimized, production-ready implementation to robotics and AR hardware companies.

steal_this: Not a weekend project — this is academic research code (an award-candidate paper) that needs serious engineering to turn into a shippable product. Worth tracking as a technology to license or hire the authors around, not to clone quickly.
